catastrophe_policy: A latent raw error above 90 degrees is diagnostic. Promotion requires zero accepted directed-shortcut errors above 90 degrees and zero hard-stop outcomes in every size-specific gate.
claim_boundary: Fresh MuJoCo contact-geometry evaluation of a shared M8/M10/M12 fingerprint model with frozen domain/size calibration. It is neither real-hardware fine-tuning nor a full-loop engagement result.
direction_label_policy: Captured/incomplete scans are mechanics-routing outcomes. They are reported separately and receive no direction label, error, APS or transport-acceptance score.
